page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right; one column of running text, full width; catchword at right below the last line; signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: melius est vt vendatur Hismaelitis,& manus
nostræ non polluantur: frater.n. & caro no-
stra est. Ita Dauid,Ecce quàm bonū & quàm
iucundū,habitare fratres in vnū. Sicut oleū
preciosum super caput, quod descēdit in bar-
bam Aaron, quod descendit in oræ vestimen-
ti eius. Sicut ros Hermon qui descendit in
montem Sion: Quoniam illic promisit Do-
minus benedictionē, & vitam vsq; in seculū.
Ita Paulus, Obsecro vos fratres, per nomen [?]
Domini nostri Iesu Christi,vt idē loquamini
omnes,& non sint inter vos dissidia,sed sitis
integrum corpus, eadē mente & eadem sen-
tentia. Sic Petrus: In pietate aut [?] subministra-
te [?] fraternam charitatem. Et Ioannes,Nos sci-
mus quòd translati sumus de morte ad vitā,
quia diligimus fratres. Qui nō diligit fratre,
manet in morte. Omnis qui odit fratrem
suum, homicida est. Et scitis quòd omnis homi-
cida non habet vitam æternam in se manen-
tem. Per hoc cognouimus charitatem,quo-
niam ille animam suam pro nobis posuit, &
nos debemus pro fratribus animas ponere.
Hæc etsi de omnibus Christianis & spiritua-
libus fratribus dicta sunt: tamen etiam ad na-
turales fratres referri possunt ac debent. Est
autem fratrū inter se concordia (vt Antisth-
enes dixit) quouis muro firmius munimentum.
Secundum, quod pulchrum est, & Deo
ac hominibus placet, est φιλία πλησίων [?], i. amor
proximorum, dum ciues & vicini mutuum
sibi diligunt: erunt enim ciuitas firma.

page.notes: The catchword "Ac" stands at the right edge, on the same line as "firma.", and is taken as the catchword of the next page. The Greek phrase after "est" is only partly legible; the second word is doubtful. Long s is printed as f in "Hifmaelitis", "fubminiftra" and "dissidia"; these are read as s. The running head is read as "NVPTIALES." and corrected to NUPTIALES. The page number at top right is partly unclear. The Latin "aut" and "subministrate" are uncertain because of the broken line. The word "per nomen" is blurred at the line break.
